name: provisioner-catalog
description: STARTcloud Provisioner Catalog — the published catalog data, the web UI, the private-catalog Worker and the docs.

scripts.lint:md: markdownlint '**/*.md' --ignore node_modules --ignore web/node_modules --ignore worker/node_modules --ignore vendor --ignore _site --ignore CHANGELOG.md
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:md
scripts.lint:fix:md: markdownlint '**/*.md' --ignore node_modules --ignore web/node_modules --ignore worker/node_modules --ignore vendor --ignore _site --ignore CHANGELOG.md --fix
scripts.lint:fix:all: npm run lint:web:fix && npm run lint:fix:md
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.fix: npm run lint:fix:all && npm run format:fix

author: STARTcloud
